newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - June 11.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SEOULBANK refused to elect a new president, protesting the government's pressure to force its head out in connection with the loans-for-kickbacks scandal involving the Hanbo Group.

- Park Chan-jong, one of presidential hopefuls of the ruling New Korea Party, strongly warned against allegedly irregular, corrupt practices, such as vote buying in the presidential nomination competition at the ruling camp.

- Defining Hanchongnyon as an organisation sympathetic to the enemy, the government has given core members of the radical student group an ultimatum until the end of July to turn themselves in or face stern punishment under the National Security Law.
